question: Which of the following minerals is necessary to maintain healthy bones and teeth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phosphorous**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Phosphorous** is essential for the formation and maintenance of healthy bones and teeth.
 
• It works closely with calcium to build strong bones and teeth, as well as to support muscle function and energy production.
